AuthErrorResponse.description: Error body of the auth endpoints when Keycloak is unreachable

errors.description: Always null: there is no field error

code.description: Authorization code Keycloak redirected back with

redirect_uri.description: Must be one of the allow-listed redirect URIs and the one used to start the flow; the first allow-listed URI when absent

state.description: `state` Keycloak redirected back with; must match the one issued by /login or /register

redirect_url.description: Keycloak URL to send the browser to (carries the `state` and the PKCE challenge)

access_token.description: JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`; keep it in memory only

bearerAuth.description: Keycloak access token returned by handleAuthCallback or refreshToken, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

post.description: Checks `state` against the HTTP-only `auth_flow` cookie, then exchanges the code (with the PKCE verifier). The access token is returned in the body; the refresh token is set as an HTTP-only cookie. The `auth_flow` cookie is cleared.

200.description: The access token; the refresh token is in an HTTP-only cookie

400.description: `redirect_uri` is not in the allow-list, or the body is unreadable

401.description: Missing `auth_flow` cookie, `state` mismatch, or code rejected by Keycloak

post.summary: Exchange the authorization code for tokens

get.description: Returns the Keycloak login URL to redirect the browser to. Sets the short-lived HTTP-only `auth_flow` cookie holding the `state` and the PKCE verifier, which `handleAuthCallback` checks.

parameters.description: Where Keycloak redirects back; must be allow-listed (`keycloak.frontend.redirect-uris`). The first allow-listed URI when absent.
parameters.name: redirect_uri

parameters.description: Language of the Keycloak page; an unsupported locale is ignored and Keycloak uses its default.
parameters.name: locale

post.description: Revokes the refresh token when present and clears the HTTP-only refresh token cookie, even if the revocation fails.

204.description: Logged out; the refresh token cookie is cleared

post.description: Uses the HTTP-only refresh token cookie and sets the rotated one. The cookie is cleared only when Keycloak rejects it; on an outage (503) it is kept.

200.description: A new access token; the new refresh token is in an HTTP-only cookie

401.description: Missing refresh token cookie, or refresh token rejected by Keycloak (cookie cleared)

get.description: Returns the Keycloak registration URL to redirect the browser to. Sets the short-lived HTTP-only `auth_flow` cookie holding the `state` and the PKCE verifier, which `handleAuthCallback` checks.

parameters.description: Where Keycloak redirects back; must be allow-listed (`keycloak.frontend.redirect-uris`). The first allow-listed URI when absent.
parameters.name: redirect_uri

parameters.description: Language of the Keycloak page; an unsupported locale is ignored and Keycloak uses its default.
parameters.name: locale
